definitions.name: Certificate readiness or renewal changed Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Certificate readiness or renewal changed.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Certificate readiness or renewal changed. Reads /apis/cert-manager.io/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/certificates?limit=500. First successful poll baselines the current finite snapshot. Later polls emit created/updated minimized resources; absent resources never emit deletion. Short-lived intermediate states and resources removed between polls can be missed. Each poll makes one HTTPS read, fails on continuation/full pages, caps the response at 2 MiB and the checkpoint at 110,000 bytes. Narrow scope rather than silently dropping events. Name-filter changes reset the baseline. Checkpoints commit before downstream completion. Downstream failure does not restore them. Resource reappearance after absence emits created; no exactly-once guarantee. Provider source: https://cert-manager.io/docs/reference/api-docs/

ingressRequirements.name: Certificate readiness or renewal changed
ingressRequirements.description: Read-only HTTPS snapshot polling; existing resources are baselined first.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; installation does not call the provider or start polling.
Save required provider credentials in Infrastructure → Secrets and configure the node with secret names only.
Grant read/list access only for /apis/cert-manager.io/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/certificates?limit=500. Use an existing trusted HTTPS endpoint on port 443; no insecure TLS bypass is implemented.
Configure baseUrl, tokenSecret and required scope fields; choose a small namespace/account and review exact name filters.
The first poll baselines existing resources; continuation/full pages fail without advancing state. Polls do not infer deletions.
Create an outbound polling ingress profile, review its network/setup plan and bind this trigger node.
Set the saved entry kind to poll and an appropriate interval of at least five seconds; enable workflow and entry deliberately.
Review first-run, cursor and bounded deduplication semantics. Checkpoints commit on trigger success before downstream completion; downstream failure does not restore them.

Select saved node entry mode poll explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/certificate-state"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
